applies_to: Passengers departing from German airports (domestic and international departures) on the first German take-off of their journey; arrivals not taxed; children under 2 without seat, crew, military/government and medical flights exempt
notes: Effective date basis: departures from 1 Jan 2011 for transactions (tickets) concluded from 1 Sep 2010 (s.19(1)). announcement_date = date of the Act; cabinet decision was June 2010 (Tweede Kamer staff note, secondary). Island flights got a reduced rate (20 percent of band 1) after EU Commission decision of 20 Dec 2012.

tax_name: Taxe de l'aviation civile (TAC; civil aviation tax), replacing the taxe de sécurité et de sûreté (TSS)
legal_basis: Art. 302 bis K CGI as rewritten by the loi de finances pour 1999 (law number not verified)
rate_structure: FRF 23 per passenger embarked for France or another EC member state; FRF 39 for other destinations (TSS in 1998: FRF 20 / 35, so about +15% / +11%). Also a per-tonne freight rate. Later EUR rates e.g. 2006-2009: EUR 4.48 (France/EU/EEA/CH) / EUR 7.60 (other); annual indexation from 2011

applies_to: Passengers (and freight) embarked in France on commercial flights, domestic and international
notes: Effective date basis: embarkations from 1 Jan 1999. Recorded as scope_change because the per-passenger TSS already existed and the security component moved to a new airport-specific 'taxe d'aéroport' (excluded here: rates set per airport). Rate change below 20 percent. Senate debate text describes the bill version; final enacted text not opened.

notes: Effective date basis: tickets issued from 1 Jul 2006 (not departures). Rates were later 1.13 / 4.51 / 11.27 / 45.07 before 2020 (increase of about 13 percent, below threshold; its date not verified).

tax_name: Addizionale commissariale per Roma Capitale sui diritti d'imbarco (Rome surcharge on boarding fees)
legal_basis: D.L. 31 maggio 2010, n. 78, art. 14, comma 14 (converted by L. 30 luglio 2010, n. 122); delibera del Commissario straordinario di Roma of 12 Nov 2010
rate_structure: EUR 1 per passenger departing Rome Fiumicino and Ciampino only (law allows up to EUR 1); total Rome levy EUR 5.50 in 2011
transfer_exempt: no: from Dec 2013 the law states it applies to all originating and transit passengers at FCO/CIA except transit passengers with domestic origin and domestic destination
notes: Airport-specific levy set by national law; relevant for FCO hub analysis.
source_quote: ADR: 'introdotta, con decorrenza 1 gennaio 2011, un'addizionale commissariale sui diritti di imbarco dei passeggeri in partenza dagli aeroporti di Roma di 1 euro per passeggero'

tax_name: Addizionale comunale sui diritti d'imbarco (municipal surcharge on boarding fees)
legal_basis: Legge 28 giugno 2012, n. 92, art. 4, comma 75
rate_structure: +EUR 2 -> EUR 6.50 per embarked passenger (EUR 7.50 at Rome FCO/CIA): +44%
transfer_exempt: no: no transfer or transit exemption found in the statute before 24 Dec 2013 (levied per embarked passenger); see 2013-12-24 row
notes: Effective date basis: 'a decorrere dal 1° luglio 2013'. Later small changes not recorded: temporary +EUR 0.32 for 2019 only; +EUR 0.50 from 1 Apr 2025 on non-EU flights from airports with at least 10 million passengers (outside window, below threshold).
source_quote: L. 92/2012 art. 4 c. 75: 'è ulteriormente incrementata, a decorrere dal 1° luglio 2013, di due euro a passeggero imbarcato'
source_type: law text; social security agency circular

tax_name: Addizionale comunale sui diritti d'imbarco (municipal surcharge on boarding fees)
legal_basis: D.L. 23 dicembre 2013, n. 145 ('Destinazione Italia'), art. 13, commi 16-17, converted by L. 21 febbraio 2014, n. 9
rate_structure: Rates unchanged (EUR 6.50; EUR 7.50 Rome)
transfer_exempt: partial: from 24 Dec 2013 passengers in transit at Italian airports are exempt only if they come from a domestic airport; passengers arriving from abroad and connecting in Italy still pay. Rome surcharge applies to transit passengers except domestic-origin-and-destination
notes: Effective date = entry into force of D.L. 145/2013 (24 Dec 2013); Normattiva shows comma 16 without conversion-amendment markers, but its application date was not checked in an implementing circular. Important for hub design: international-to-international transfer at FCO/MXP stays taxed.
source_quote: Art. 13 c. 16: the addizionale 'non è dovuta dai passeggeri in transito negli scali aeroportuali nazionali, se provenienti da scali domestici'

tax_name: Imposta erariale sui voli dei passeggeri di aerotaxi (state tax on air-taxi passengers)
legal_basis: D.L. 6 dicembre 2011, n. 201, art. 16, comma 10-bis, inserted by D.L. 2 marzo 2012, n. 16, converted by L. 26 aprile 2012, n. 44
rate_structure: Per passenger per leg: EUR 100 (up to 1,500 km), EUR 200 (over 1,500 km) as enacted; current scheme EUR 10 (up to 100 km), EUR 100 (100-1,500 km), EUR 200 (over 1,500 km)
transfer_exempt: not stated
applies_to: Air-taxi (non-scheduled small aircraft and helicopter) passengers on legs departing and/or arriving in Italy; not scheduled airline traffic
notes: Niche tax, not relevant for scheduled hub traffic. effective_date blank: start date and the date the EUR 10 band was added not verified. Commi 10-bis ff. shown as repealed by D.Lgs. 5 novembre 2024, n. 174 on Normattiva (effective date of repeal not checked).
source_quote: 'E' istituita l'imposta erariale sui voli dei passeggeri di aerotaxi ... euro 100 in caso di tragitto non superiore a 1.500 chilometri e a euro 200 in caso di tragitto superiore a 1.500 chilometri'
source_type: law text (coordinated text, customs agency); tax authority

legal_basis: Finance (No. 2) Act 2008 (No. 25 of 2008), s.55; Air Travel Tax Regulations 2009 (S.I. No. 134 of 2009)
rate_structure: Per departing passenger: EUR 2 if destination not more than 300 km from Dublin Airport (all domestic flights and some UK airports); EUR 10 otherwise
transfer_exempt: yes: transit (same aircraft) and transfer passengers exempt; transfer = arrives and departs on a further flight (not back to the origin airport), both flights on a single booking, not more than 6 h between scheduled arrival and scheduled departure
applies_to: Passengers departing Irish airports with at least 50,000 departing passengers in the previous year (Dublin, Cork, Shannon, Waterford, Kerry, Galway, Knock) on aircraft with 20+ seats; arrivals not taxed
notes: Effective date basis: departures on or after 30 Mar 2009 regardless of booking date. Announced in Budget 2009 (October 2008) per Oireachtas/Commission on Taxation search snippets, not opened.
source_quote: s.55(2)(a): air travel tax 'shall be charged, levied and paid in respect of every departure of a passenger on an aircraft from an airport on or after 30 March 2009'

legal_basis: Finance Act 2011, s.48 amending s.55 Finance (No. 2) Act 2008 (per Revenue manual)
rate_structure: Flat EUR 3 per departing passenger (from EUR 2 short / EUR 10 other): +50% short, -70% other; distance band removed
transfer_exempt: yes: transit (same aircraft) and transfer passengers exempt; transfer = arrives and departs on a further flight (not back to the origin airport), both flights on a single booking, not more than 6 h between scheduled arrival and scheduled departure
applies_to: Passengers departing the qualifying Irish airports
notes: Effective date basis: departures from 1 Mar 2011. Section-level attribution of the rate change to FA 2011 s.48 is from the Revenue manual list of amending acts, not checked in the Act.
source_quote: 'The rate of ATT was €3 per passenger departing from an airport from 1 March 2011 to 31 March 2014.'

legal_basis: Air Travel Tax (Abolition) Order 2014 (S.I. No. 130 of 2014)
rate_structure: EUR 0 / tax ceased
transfer_exempt: not applicable
notes: Effective date basis: departures from 1 Apr 2014. Announced in Budget 2014 (Oct 2013), not verified.
source_quote: 'The Air Travel Tax (Abolition) Order (S.I.130 of 2014), signed by the Minister of Finance, abolished ATT with effect from 1 April 2014.'

legal_basis: Finance Act 1994, ss.28-44 and Schs 5A, 6
rate_structure: GBP 5 if the journey ends in the UK, an EU state or associated territory within the area 32W-32E and 26N-81N; GBP 10 otherwise
transfer_exempt: yes: a passenger is not chargeable on a second or later flight that is connected to the previous one and shown on the ticket (FA 1994 s.31(3)); connected = onward international departure within 24 h of scheduled arrival; domestic-to-domestic within 6 h (arrival 04:00-17:00) or by 10:00 (other arrival times); not connected if the onward flight returns to the origin airport/country (SI 1994/1821)
applies_to: Passengers departing UK airports on aircraft of at least 10 t or 20+ seats; arrivals not taxed; one charge per journey (connected onward flights not charged)
notes: PRE-1996 baseline. Effective date (1 Nov 1994) from a secondary source (IHS report: 'im Vereinigten Königreich seit 01.11.1994'); the FA 1994 commencement provision itself was not opened.
source_quote: NI Assembly: 'when APD was introduced in 1994 two bands were created: the closest foreign destinations and UK internal travel carried a levy of £5; while further afield destinations carried a levy of £10'
source_type: law text; legislature research paper; research report

rate_structure: Doubled: GBP 10 (UK/EEA area) / GBP 20 (other)
transfer_exempt: yes: a passenger is not chargeable on a second or later flight that is connected to the previous one and shown on the ticket (FA 1994 s.31(3)); connected = onward international departure within 24 h of scheduled arrival; domestic-to-domestic within 6 h (arrival 04:00-17:00) or by 10:00 (other arrival times); not connected if the onward flight returns to the origin airport/country (SI 1994/1821)
notes: Effective date basis: duty becoming due (carriage) on or after 1 Nov 1997.
source_quote: s.9: 'for £5 there shall be substituted £10' ... applies where duty 'becomes due on or after 1st November 1997'

legal_basis: Finance Act 2000, ss.18-19
rate_structure: Class differentiation introduced: EEA destinations GBP 5 standard (lowest) class / GBP 10 other classes; other destinations GBP 20 standard / GBP 40 other. Changes: EEA economy -50%; non-EEA premium +100%
transfer_exempt: yes: a passenger is not chargeable on a second or later flight that is connected to the previous one and shown on the ticket (FA 1994 s.31(3)); connected = onward international departure within 24 h of scheduled arrival; domestic-to-domestic within 6 h (arrival 04:00-17:00) or by 10:00 (other arrival times); not connected if the onward flight returns to the origin airport/country (SI 1994/1821)
notes: Effective date basis: carriage beginning on or after 1 Apr 2001. Standard class later defined to exclude seat pitch over 40 inches (FA 2008 s.153).
source_quote: s.18: 'This section applies to any carriage of a passenger on an aircraft which begins on or after 1st April 2001.'

legal_basis: Finance Act 2007, s.12
rate_structure: Doubled: EEA GBP 10 standard / 20 other; non-EEA GBP 40 standard / 80 other
transfer_exempt: yes: a passenger is not chargeable on a second or later flight that is connected to the previous one and shown on the ticket (FA 1994 s.31(3)); connected = onward international departure within 24 h of scheduled arrival; domestic-to-domestic within 6 h (arrival 04:00-17:00) or by 10:00 (other arrival times); not connected if the onward flight returns to the origin airport/country (SI 1994/1821)
notes: Effective date basis: carriage beginning on or after 1 Feb 2007 (announced in the Dec 2006 Pre-Budget Report; not verified).
source_quote: s.12: amendments 'have effect in relation to any carriage of a passenger on an aircraft which begins on or after 1st February 2007'

legal_basis: Finance Act 2009, s.17 (new FA 1994 s.30(1)-(4A)) and Sch. 5
rate_structure: Four distance bands by distance of destination country's capital from London: A (0-2,000 miles) GBP 11 standard / 22 other; B (2,001-4,000) 45 / 90; C (4,001-6,000) 50 / 100; D (over 6,000) 55 / 110
transfer_exempt: yes: a passenger is not chargeable on a second or later flight that is connected to the previous one and shown on the ticket (FA 1994 s.31(3)); connected = onward international departure within 24 h of scheduled arrival; domestic-to-domestic within 6 h (arrival 04:00-17:00) or by 10:00 (other arrival times); not connected if the onward flight returns to the origin airport/country (SI 1994/1821)
notes: Effective date basis: carriage beginning on or after 1 Nov 2009. Band mileages from the NI Assembly table (bands defined in law by country lists in Sch. 5A). Long-haul rises: e.g. non-EEA economy 40 -> 45 (B) to 55 (D).
source_quote: s.17(3): 'The amendment made by subsection (1) has effect in relation to the carriage of passengers beginning on or after 1 November 2009.'

legal_basis: Finance Act 2010 (c.13), s.14
transfer_exempt: yes: a passenger is not chargeable on a second or later flight that is connected to the previous one and shown on the ticket (FA 1994 s.31(3)); connected = onward international departure within 24 h of scheduled arrival; domestic-to-domestic within 6 h (arrival 04:00-17:00) or by 10:00 (other arrival times); not connected if the onward flight returns to the origin airport/country (SI 1994/1821)
notes: Effective date basis: carriage beginning on or after 1 Nov 2010. Following increases (1 Apr 2012: A 13/26, B 65/130, C 81/162, D 92/184; 1 Apr 2013 and 1 Apr 2014) were each below 20 percent; FA 2012 Sch. 23 also added a higher rate for large private jets.
source_quote: s.14: 'have effect in relation to the carriage of passengers beginning on or after 1 November 2010'

tax_name: Air Passenger Duty (APD), Northern Ireland direct long-haul
legal_basis: Rate cut applied from 1 Nov 2011, given statutory effect by Finance Act 2012, Sch. 23 paras 1-3
rate_structure: Direct long-haul flights (bands B-D) departing Northern Ireland charged at the band A rate: GBP 12 standard / 24 other (instead of up to GBP 85 / 170)
transfer_exempt: yes: a passenger is not chargeable on a second or later flight that is connected to the previous one and shown on the ticket (FA 1994 s.31(3)); connected = onward international departure within 24 h of scheduled arrival; domestic-to-domestic within 6 h (arrival 04:00-17:00) or by 10:00 (other arrival times); not connected if the onward flight returns to the origin airport/country (SI 1994/1821)
applies_to: Only passengers whose journey begins in Northern Ireland on a direct flight to a non-band-A destination; the rest of the UK unchanged
notes: Regional (NI) event, relevant as competition with Dublin. Effective date from NI Assembly research paper and NIA 2012/5 explanatory notes.
source_quote: NI Assembly: 'the rate reduction, which had been applied to long haul flights departing from Northern Ireland between 1 November 2011 and 31 March 2012'

tax_name: Air Passenger Duty (APD), Northern Ireland direct long-haul
legal_basis: Air Passenger Duty (Setting of Rate) Act (Northern Ireland) 2012 (2012 c.5, Royal Assent 11 Dec 2012) under FA 1994 s.30A
rate_structure: GBP 0 for direct long-haul flights (bands B-D) beginning in Northern Ireland
transfer_exempt: yes: a passenger is not chargeable on a second or later flight that is connected to the previous one and shown on the ticket (FA 1994 s.31(3)); connected = onward international departure within 24 h of scheduled arrival; domestic-to-domestic within 6 h (arrival 04:00-17:00) or by 10:00 (other arrival times); not connected if the onward flight returns to the origin airport/country (SI 1994/1821)
applies_to: Passengers on direct long-haul flights from Northern Ireland whose first flight is not followed by a connected flight within the UK or band A
notes: effective_date is the 'intended' relevant day stated in the explanatory notes; the commencement order was not checked.
source_quote: Explanatory notes: 'It is intended that this will be the 1 January 2013.'

legal_basis: Finance Act 2014, s.79 (omitting FA 1994 s.30(3)-(4)); prior 2014 rates from FA 2014 s.78
rate_structure: Bands C and D abolished: two bands A (0-2,000 miles) GBP 13 / 26 and B (over 2,000 miles) GBP 71 / 142. From 2014 rates B 69/138, C 85/170, D 97/194: D -27%, C -16%, B +3%
transfer_exempt: yes: a passenger is not chargeable on a second or later flight that is connected to the previous one and shown on the ticket (FA 1994 s.31(3)); connected = onward international departure within 24 h of scheduled arrival; domestic-to-domestic within 6 h (arrival 04:00-17:00) or by 10:00 (other arrival times); not connected if the onward flight returns to the origin airport/country (SI 1994/1821)
notes: Effective date basis: carriage beginning on or after 1 Apr 2015. Large cut for very long-haul (former band D, e.g. East Asia, Australia).
source_quote: s.79(12): 'The amendments made by this section have effect in relation to the carriage of passengers beginning on or after 1 April 2015.'

legal_basis: Finance (No. 2) Act 2023 (c.30), s.322 (new FA 1994 s.30(1B) and (2A), new Part 1A of Sch. 5A)
rate_structure: New domestic band (journey ends in the UK): GBP 6.50 reduced / 13 standard (half the band A rate); band A GBP 13 / 26; new band B (Part 1A) GBP 87 / 191; band C (other, ultra long-haul) GBP 91 / 200; higher rate (large private jets) up to GBP 601
transfer_exempt: yes: a passenger is not chargeable on a second or later flight that is connected to the previous one and shown on the ticket (FA 1994 s.31(3)); connected = onward international departure within 24 h of scheduled arrival; domestic-to-domestic within 6 h (arrival 04:00-17:00) or by 10:00 (other arrival times); not connected if the onward flight returns to the origin airport/country (SI 1994/1821)
notes: Effective date basis: carriage beginning on or after 1 Apr 2023. Band mileage limits (B up to 5,500 miles) are commonly reported but were not read in the law here. Scotland legislated an Air Departure Tax (2017) to replace APD but it was never brought into force (not verified in detail).
source_quote: FA 1994 s.30(1B): 'If the passenger's journey ends at a place in the United Kingdom ... the rate is £6.50'; inserted '(1.4.2023 in relation to the carriage of passengers beginning on or after that date)'
